description: Erection of a rear extension at third floor level, on top of the existing back addition.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed extension over the rear addition, by reason of it's location, scale and proximity to neighbouring properties would result in an unneighbourly dorm of development which would be detrimental to neighbouring residential amenity. The development would result in an unacceptable loss of outlook, sense of enclosure and loss of privacy for the neighbours at 8 and 9 Barb Mews, and an unacceptable loss of light and outlook for the neighbour at 162 Shepherd's Bush Road. The proposal s contrary to Policy HO11 of the Local Plan 2018 and Key Principles HS6 and HS7 of the Planning Guidance SPD 2018.

Reason : 2 - The proposed extension, by reason of its position form and scale, would result in an overly dominant and incompatible development to the host property. The position above the existing rear addition and height of the extension beyond the existing eaves of the property would result in an overly prominent feature which would not be subservient to the existing property. This would result in minor harm to the significance of the Brook Green Conservation Area. Therefore, the proposal is contrary to policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan 2018 as well as Key Principles CAG2 and CAG3 of the Planning Guidance SPD 2018, as well as Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.
